This YouTube channel focuses on videos showcasing the OTZ Method of chiropractic adjustment. OTZ Methods develops chiropractors through its brand of observation and approach titled “TOP DOWN ANALYSIS”, which involves specific correction of the occipital-atlanto subluxation and then moves down sequentially through the spine. 

Please visit our website at www.otzhealthed.com for more information on the OTZ Method or to register for one of our chiropractic seminars.
